title: Isolate lint runtime per-language and add smart merge prober
author: Maya Chen
description:
Context: Our monolithic lint presubmit has grown brittle and noisy as we onboarded multiple language stacks. Several flakes and long cold-starts were traced to a single lint runtime that bootstraps all linters (node/python/go/rust) on every presubmit. This PR splits the lint runtime so each language has a minimal, language-focused executor and adds a lightweight 'smart merge prober' that verifies release windows are quiet and triggers silent pre-merge smoke checks when the release gate is open.

Motivation: reduce presubmit latency, eliminate unrelated linter noise for changes that only touch one language, and reduce build resource contention on ephemeral runners.

Summary of changes (high level):
1) Introduce a new runtimes/linters/{node,python,go} folder with minimal bootstraps that only install runtime deps needed for that language.
2) Add a 'slim' executor mode that uses preseeded cached toolchains for fast local CI and for the GitHub Actions self-hosted group.
3) Implement smart-merge-prober action (actions/smart-merge-prober.yml) that checks recent merge queue activity, last green release smoke, and optionally runs an isolated smoke job before allowing auto-merge windows.
4) Bump golangci-lint to 1.59.0 and eslint to 8.49.0, pin node-setup and actions/checkout versions, and update the composite lint action to call the language-specific executors.
5) Add metrics and telemetry hooks: ci.lint.duration_by_language and ci.merge_prober.probe_latency.
6) Documentation updates: docs/ci/lint.md and README for the smart prober.

Checklist:
- [x] Split runtime scaffolds per language
- [x] Add slim executor and gate path
- [x] Implement smart merge prober action with opt-in label support
- [x] Add migration guide for repo owners
- [x] Validate no regressions on main (smoke nightly)
- [x] Updated docs and release notes

Commits and deployment notes: squash of 7 commits into a single change at merge. Key intermediate commits include: 'introduce language runtimes scaffold', 'slim executor: use preseed cache + fastpath', 'actions: add smart-merge-prober', 'bump: golangci-lint@1.59.0 eslint@8.49.0', 'docs: lint migration and prober guide', 'ci: add telemetry hooks and dashboard panels'.

Migration: repo owners can opt into the new per-language presubmit by adding the label 'ci:lang-presubmit=node' (or python/go) on large cross-language rollouts; default behaviour for now preserves the legacy composite action until 2026-04-01.

Configuration knobs: LINT_EXECUTOR_MODE: slim|full, MERGE_PROBER_ENABLED: true|false, PROBER_WINDOW: 15m|30m|1h.

Changed areas (representative):
- ci/actions/composite-lint.yml (rewired to dispatcher only)
- ci/actions/node-executor.yml (new)
- ci/actions/python-executor.yml (new)
- ci/actions/go-executor.yml (new)
- .github/actions/smart-merge-prober/action.yml (new)
- tools/ci/cache-preseed/ (new scripts to populate slim caches)
- docs/ci/lint.md (updated)
- dashboards/ci-lint.json (added panels)

Testing and CI: Ran full matrix on staging runners, nightly smoke runs for two weeks against main. Observed median presubmit latency drop from ~6m45s to ~2m40s for single-language changes. golangci-lint baseline found 12 new warnings in internal/host-provision; these were addressed in a follow-up commit that is part of the squash. CI matrix: node, python, go shards pass; integration smoke and release-prober smoke pass. One intermittent flaky test in examples/node/streaming.test.js was quarantined and ticketed (ENG-7616).

Operational impact:
- Rollout plan: opt-in per-repo for 2 weeks, then gradual default switch.
- Metrics to watch: ci.lint.duration_by_language, premerge-failure-rate, merge-prober.probe_latency, and presubmit-run-cost.
- Rollback: revert composite-lint-dispatcher to call legacy composite action (we kept the previous workflow as ci/actions/composite-lint.legacy.yml during the opt-in window).

Release notes:
- Introduce per-language lint runtimes and a 'slim' executor to reduce presubmit latency.
- Add smart merge prober to safely allow auto-merge windows with an optional pre-merge smoke run.
- Upgrade golangci-lint and eslint, and add telemetry for lint/runtime performance.

Rationale and caveats: We intentionally kept the dispatcher small and language executors independently versioned to allow per-language upgrades without touching others. The smart merge prober is conservative by default (disabled) and requires a repo opt-in label or admin toggle. We also added a migration doc to walk teams through pinning the old behaviour if they rely on the monolithic checks. This PR is focused on CI/infra and should not change runtime product code. If any regressions appear in the first week after opt-in, the prober can be disabled via MERGE_PROBER_ENABLED=false for the repository environment variable.
commits_summary: 7 logical commits squashed. Key work: scaffolding per-language executors, slim executor cache preseed, smart merge prober action, linter bumps, telemetry and docs.
review_comments: Luca Ramirez: Left a couple of nits around the slim executor env var naming; suggested LINT_EXECUTOR_MODE instead of EXEC_MODE.
Priya Nair: Asked for rationale for pinning eslint to 8.49.0 rather than using caret ranges; agreed to pin for isolation during rollout.
Owen Patel: Requested that we add a small e2e that runs smart-merge-prober in dry-run mode; added a commit implementing prober dry-run tests.
Maya Chen (author): Replied explaining rollout plan and added migration docs; addressed nits in follow-up commit.
CI bot: All matrix jobs passed after second run; one flaky test quarantined (examples/node/streaming.test.js) and bumped to flaky-tests label.
notes: This PR was intentionally kept to infra, build tooling, and docs. Product code unaffected. Teams should watch presubmit queue heat after default flip and report any skipped cross-language coverage that may surface.
post_merge_actions: Create Linear follow-ups ENG-7616 (quarantine flaky node stream test), ENG-7690 (observe presubmit cost for 2 weeks), and schedule a retro after full repo opt-in.
release_notes_short: Per-language lint executors, slim executor mode, smart merge prober action, linter bumps and telemetry.
notes_for_changelog: ci: split lint runtime by language; add slim executor and smart merge prober; bump golangci-lint & eslint; update docs and dashboards
testing_summary: Staging matrix ran 3 times; nightly smoke for 14 days; manual dry-run of prober for two release windows. Observed significant latency improvement for single-language changes.
backout_plan: Re-enable legacy composite action by renaming ci/actions/composite-lint.legacy.yml back to composite-lint.yml and flip LINT_EXECUTOR_MODE to full in repo environment; revert PR if any major regressions are found.
ci_artifacts: CI artifacts available under action run 467224 and 467255 (staging) containing executor logs and prober dry-run traces.
